validation: Saved first-pass MIDI decoded against original-ROM trace: attacks, pitches, gates, programs, duty, levels, detune, glide, tempo and markers. Later-loop detune carry-over intentionally excluded from this shortened example.
heldProgramBehavior: MM Studio 0.5.1 applies native instrument changes to sounding notes without a new attack.
loopTuning: Repeats first-pass tuning; later native passes carry a +1 Pulse 2 detune in some phrases.
